biocontainers.name: bioconductor-meshdbi
biocontainers.summary: The package is a unified implementation of mesh.db, mesh.aor.db, and mesh.pcr.db and also is interfaced to construct gene-mesh package (mesh.xxx.eg.db). loadmeshdbipkg import sqlite file and generate mesh.xxx.eg.db.

biotools.summary: The package is unified implementation of MeSH.db, MeSH.AOR.db, and MeSH.PCR.db and also is interface to construct Gene-MeSH package (MeSH.XXX.eg.db). loadMeSHDbiPkg import sqlite file and generate MeSH.XXX.eg.db.
